theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_tangent_cone_density_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → ∀ t : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < t → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μHE[n] (M ∩ ({z | 2 * ‖Q.starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ)) ≤ t * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
